title: Serum worker v1 decoded packet header
description: Wire header is eight bytes: literal DMDW, uint8 version, uint8 operation, uint16 little-endian payload length. Operation 4 is the worker's unsolicited startup acknowledgement. Reset starts a fresh process. Invalid or truncated requests terminate the worker.

oneOf.description: Frame. Payload is 128 by 32 row-major bytes in 0..3.
Advance. Payload is uint32 little-endian elapsed milliseconds in 0..60000. Sleep then call Serum_Rotate once.

Result, flags, trigger ID, rotation timer, tester frame ID and width32 as six little-endian uint32s. A new or rotated 32p plane appends 4096 little-endian RGB565 words. The production mode suppresses tester ID with 0xffffffff.
